description: Issue 5 (P2): startLiveClass returns HTTP 409 (not 500) when the live_classes_legacy_start_guard trigger rejects a LEGACY session start, via a named message constant and matcher in utils/liveClassMicrophoneContract.js and a narrow catch-branch dispatch in the controller, plus unit tests for both the helper and the controller dispatch. The dispatch unit tests use jest.mock('../utils/prisma') — the design review's finding that mocking controller-internal rawFindLiveClass/rawUpdateLiveClassStatus is infeasible is resolved by mocking the shared prisma module instead (the controller closes over it at module scope).
steps: In backend/src/utils/liveClassMicrophoneContract.js add: const LEGACY_SESSION_START_REJECTION_MESSAGE = 'Cannot start LEGACY session; upgrade microphone_authorization_mode to SFU_AUTHORITATIVE first'; and function isTriggerLegacyStartRejection(err) { return Boolean(err && err.message && err.message.includes(LEGACY_SESSION_START_REJECTION_MESSAGE)); }. Export both in module.exports alongside the existing exports.

In backend/src/controllers/live-class.controller.js update the line-9 destructured import from '../utils/liveClassMicrophoneContract' to also pull LEGACY_SESSION_START_REJECTION_MESSAGE and isTriggerLegacyStartRejection.

Replace startLiveClass's final catch (currently '} catch (e) { next(e); }' around line ~889, the one following 'return successResponse(res, updated, \'Class started\')') with: if (isTriggerLegacyStartRejection(e)) { return errorResponse(res, 'The microphone authorization mode must be upgraded before starting this class.', 409); } next(e); — with the SEC01-G-BE02 comment from the design. Do NOT change any other catch block; do not touch ensureProtectedScheduledMicrophoneMode or the success path.

In backend/src/tests/live-class-microphone-unit-a.test.js add: (a) helper tests — isTriggerLegacyStartRejection true for a wrapped message containing the constant, false for 'Connection refused', 'ER_ROW_IS_REFERENCED_2', null, {}; (b) a new describe('startLiveClass error dispatch') block that: jest.mock('../utils/prisma', () => ({ __esModule: false, default: undefined, $queryRawUnsafe: jest.fn(), $executeRawUnsafe: jest.fn(), liveClass: { findFirst: jest.fn(), create: jest.fn(), update: jest.fn(), delete: jest.fn(), findUnique: jest.fn() } })) — match the actual shape utils/prisma exports (read it first); also jest.mock('../sockets', () => ({ getIo: () => null })) and jest.mock('../utils/feedLive', () => ({ broadcastLiveStart: jest.fn(), broadcastLiveEnd: jest.fn() })) and jest.mock('../services/liveclass-microphone-authority.service', () => ({ assertProtectedRuntimeReady: jest.fn() })).

Dispatch 409 case: $queryRawUnsafe resolves once with a class row { id, streamType: 'PUBLIC', schoolId: null, classId: null, status: 'SCHEDULED', microphone_authorization_mode: 'SFU_AUTHORITATIVE', duration: null, deletedAt: null, ... } (rawFindLiveClass returns it; ensureProtectedScheduledMicrophoneMode sees mode != LEGACY so it is a no-op); $executeRawUnsafe rejects with Error('...Cannot start LEGACY session; upgrade microphone_authorization_mode to SFU_AUTHORITATIVE first'). Call startLiveClass(req, res, next) with req = { params: { id }, user: { id: 'host', role: 'TEACHER' } }, res = { status: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(), json: jest.fn() }, next = jest.fn(). Assert res.status called with 409, next not called, and the JSON payload contains none of 'SQLSTATE', '45000', 'trigger', 'LEGACY' raw SQL text.
Dispatch 500 case: same setup but $executeRawUnsafe rejects with Error('Connection refused'). Assert next called with the error and res.status never called with 409.

Note: the mock for '../utils/prisma' must satisfy every other module that requires it in the controller's dependency graph (auth middleware, liveClassAudit, etc.) — if a require-time shape error appears, extend the mock object, do not switch approaches. If a genuine blocker arises that would change user-visible behavior, stop and signal warning per the workflow rules.
Commit with message 'feat(live-class): return HTTP 409 for LEGACY start-guard trigger rejection (Issue 5)'.
acceptance_criteria: startLiveClass returns 409 with a clean user message when the error message contains the trigger rejection text; all other errors pass through next(e).
The 409 response body contains no SQLSTATE value, no 45000, no trigger name, no raw SQL.
isTriggerLegacyStartRejection and the constant are exported from utils/liveClassMicrophoneContract.js.
Unit tests cover the helper (positive + negative cases incl. null/{}), the 409 dispatch, and the 500 dispatch, all passing.
The rest of the unit suite stays green (no other catch block changed).
verification: cd backend; node --check src/utils/liveClassMicrophoneContract.js; node --check src/controllers/live-class.controller.js; node --check src/tests/live-class-microphone-unit-a.test.js — exit 0.
cd backend; node test-safety/run-jest.js src/tests/live-class-microphone-unit-a.test.js — all tests in the file pass (existing + new).
cd backend; npm run test:unit — full safe unit suite green (no regressions from the controller/contract change).
